name: DAPO

citation.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

deltas.change: filter prompts whose groups have zero reward variance and resample until the batch is full (iter-41 schema bump captured this on loss_form.sampling_dynamic_filter)
token-level policy-gradient loss (mean over all tokens in the batch rather than per-sequence averaging)
soft length-aware penalty for truncated/overlong completions (iter-41 schema bump captured this on loss_form.reward_shaping_type, value 'overlong_penalty')
KL regularization term removed from the objective (canonical leaf pinned at kl_beta=0.0)

notes: Four named techniques plus removal of the KL term, per the source paper. field: paths now anchored on iter-41 schema leaves (iter-42 drift audit: previous sampling.* and reward.* references were blocks the schema never exposed). | iter-94 surrogate-marker: The tinker_dapo_qwen3.5-4b_gsm8k stack record is a LABEL-FLIP SURROGATE only: variant_deltas_applied enumerates clip_higher as 'surrogate' (asymmetric clip enforced via user config, managed loss internals unverifiable), dynamic_sampling as 'absent' (no group filter-and-resample hook), token_level_loss as 'unknown' (managed_by_tinker), overlong_reward_shaping as 'absent' (no length-aware penalty), and kl_removed as 'unknown' (kl_beta managed). Adding a measured row sourced from that stack record would advertise the surrogate as the real DAPO algorithm. Measured block intentionally null: same-stack DAPO arm (with all five components enforced) does not exist in the worktree. To be measured once a same-stack arm lands (criterion: same model + task + sampler + RLHF pipeline with all five DAPO components actually enforced, not just label-named).

expected_effects.rationale: DAPO's dynamic_sampling filter explicitly resamples zero-variance groups; predicted lower ZVF than GRPO on the same stack (Yu et al. 2025, Section 3.2).
DAPO's overlong_reward_shaping soft-penalizes truncated completions; predicted lower mean_len on the same stack (Yu et al. 2025, Section 3.4).

DAPO's clip_higher (asymmetric 0.2/0.28) prevents premature convergence on low-entropy prompts while permitting exploration on high-entropy ones; predicted higher reward_mean on the same stack (Yu et al. 2025, Table 2).
